Record notes

Four complete methods for Figma operation, source references, visual QA and an inspectable handoff.

Version 0.1.1 includes 4 complete skill procedures. Complete method package; Figma service remains external.

Requirements: Figma account; Host Figma connector or browser tools.

License scope: MIT. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add figma-design-workflow@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.
